name: AWS - EC2
notes: boto3 DescribeInstances is the EC2 query protocol. POST / matches Action=DescribeInstances from the form body or the query string and returns DescribeInstancesResponse XML in the namespace http://ec2.amazonaws.com/doc/2016-11-15/.

reservationSet/item/instancesSet/item includes instanceId, imageId, instanceType, instanceState, launchTime, and placement. requestId is a sibling. MaxResults pages the catalog. The next page token is nextToken and is sent back as NextToken.
Network interfaces, tags, and block devices are omitted. The token is pp_ plus a base36 index, which boto3 sends back unchanged. Version is not checked. SigV4 is not checked.
